title: A Message About the Weekend
gist_ar: رسالة صوتية من صاحبتك بتحكي فيها إيه اللي عملته في الويكند وطالبة إنك تكلمها.

before_listening.en: You will hear a voice message from a friend. Listen ONCE and decide why she called. Do not open the transcript yet.
before_listening.ar: هتسمع رسالة صوتية من صاحبتك. اسمع مرة واحدة وحدّد هي بتكلمك ليه. متفتحش النص لسه.

segments.speaker: Salma
segments.text: Hi Mona, it's Salma. Sorry I missed your call yesterday. I wanted to tell you about my weekend, because it was really busy. On Saturday morning I cleaned the whole flat. Then my cousin arrived from Alexandria, so we cooked lunch together and we talked for hours. On Sunday we walked to the old market and I bought a small lamp for my room. It only cost eighty pounds. In the evening I watched a film with my sister, but I was so tired that I closed my eyes after twenty minutes. Anyway, please call me back tonight. I finish work at six. Bye!

gist_question.q: Why did Salma leave this message?
options: To ask Mona to help her clean the flat
To tell Mona about her busy weekend and ask her to call back
To invite Mona to travel to Alexandria

questions.q: What did Salma buy at the market?
What time does Salma finish work?
